title: Phase estimation in spontaneous nonlinear interferometry for enhanced quantum imaging
summary: Bicolor quantum imaging can reach, in principle, phase supersensitivity approaching the Heisenberg limit using squeezed light from high-gain parametric down-conversion, but established quantum-imaging setups typically operate in the low-gain, spontaneous regime, where such scaling is inaccessible.
